instruction: Fix `mean` in `numstats/descriptive.py` so it raises a `ValueError` when given an empty sequence. `mean([])` currently crashes with a `ZeroDivisionError` instead of reporting the empty-input error.
gold_patch:
diff --git a/numstats/descriptive.py b/numstats/descriptive.py
--- a/numstats/descriptive.py
+++ b/numstats/descriptive.py
@@ -5,6 +5,8 @@
 
 def mean(data):
     """Return the arithmetic mean of ``data``. Raises ValueError on empty input."""
+    if len(data) == 0:
+        raise ValueError("mean of empty sequence")
     return sum(data) / len(data)
